help.title: Help
help.intro: MeetingLens is a development preview for reviewing local meeting transcripts and testing the desktop workflow.
help.availableBody: You can paste or import UTF-8 TXT, SRT and VTT transcripts, review and correct them locally, then explicitly authorize DeepSeek to generate structured meeting minutes. Completed minutes can be reviewed, edited, copied as canonical Markdown or saved as a Markdown file.
help.unavailableBody: Recording, realtime transcription, screen capture, speaker diarization, realtime translation, video import, Docling product orchestration, section-level regeneration and complex document export are not available yet.
help.quickStartBody: Open Summary mode, paste notes or choose a TXT, SRT or VTT transcript, review the normalized segments, and open Meeting minutes. Choose the sources, template and output language, review the external-sharing disclosure, then generate. You can edit the completed body, preview or copy canonical Markdown, save it, or create a full new revision.
help.filesBody: Open a meeting and use Add files. Approved files are copied into private application storage and can be deleted without changing the source file. Docling is not connected to this UI yet.
help.deepseekBody: Use Settings to save the key in Windows Credential Manager. The WebView cannot read it back. The Rust-only DeepSeek provider consumes it only when executing a frozen, explicitly authorized Summary run; the WebView never receives the key or sends provider requests.
help.privacyBody: Submitted transcript segments and generated minutes stay in MeetingLens private local storage. Unsubmitted pasted text is cleared on cancel or after saving, and source paths never reach the WebView. Only the frozen transcript scope shown in the disclosure can be sent by the Rust provider after explicit confirmation; content already received by DeepSeek cannot be recalled.
help.faqBody: Changing the interface language does not translate transcript content or change the selected minutes output language. Clearing WebView storage resets only the interface-language preference, not local meetings or transcripts.
help.feedbackBody: When reporting a problem, include the action, safe error code and application version. Never attach API keys, recordings, meeting content, local databases or private paths.
help.guidesBody: The repository includes matching Simplified Chinese and English development-preview guides.
